newsitem.title: USA: Ambac qualifies nine issues for bond insurance.
newsitem.headline: Ambac qualifies nine issues for bond insurance.

text.p: Ambac Assurance Corp said it has qualified for bond insurance the following nine municipal issues scheduled for competitive sale today.
--Coachella Valley USD, Calif., $10 million general obligation bonds.
--South San Francisco USD, Calif., $10 million GOs.
--Montague Public Schools, Mich., $11.855 million school building and site bonds.
--Hopkinton N.H. School District, N.H., $6.992 million school GOs.
--Southampton Town, N.Y., $4.150 million various purpose bonds.
--First Colony Municipal Util., Texas, $3.310 million unlimited tax bonds.
